recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中出現大量中大型淋巴樣細胞，核呈多葉、腦迴或花瓣狀（flower cells），胞質淡藍嗜鹼性；CSF 中出現這種多葉核 T 細胞，配合 HTLV-1 陽性與高血鈣，指向成人 T 細胞白血病／淋巴瘤中樞神經侵犯。
features: Numerous medium to large atypical lymphoid cells in a cytocentrifuge preparation
Markedly convoluted, multilobated nuclei with clover-leaf/flower-like configurations (arrows)
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm
Few red cells and no neutrophils in the background; some cells show cytospin distortion
describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytocentrifuge preparation (Wright-Giemsa) shows a markedly increased population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells. Many cells have deeply convoluted, multilobated, flower-like nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm. Inflammatory cells such as neutrophils are not seen, and no mitotic figures or large nucleoli are evident. In conjunction with a CD4+/CD7-/CD25+ T-cell phenotype, positive HTLV-1 serology and hypercalcemia, the findings are consistent with CNS involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Sézary syndrome / mycosis fungoides with CNS spread
ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than petal-like lobation, are usually CD25-negative, and occur without HTLV-1 infection.
Reactive CSF lymphocytes are mostly small with round nuclei and are admixed with monocytes and plasma cells, lacking a monomorphic flower-cell population.

ddx.dx: Cytospin artifact of neutrophils or monocytes
ddx.vs: Degenerating neutrophils have pyknotic separate lobes with granular pink cytoplasm and monocytes have folded nuclei with grey vacuolated cytoplasm, not basophilic lymphoid cytoplasm.
PTCL may show nuclear irregularity but lacks HTLV-1 clonal integration and the typical CD25-bright flower-cell morphology.
